It also rides on 24" DDC forged Ten wheels in gloss black with milled details, fitted as a direct-bolt dually package, and paired with LT315/50R24 Nitto Recon Grappler tires. The bodywork and stance are matched by the long bed, while the Front License Plate Bracket is present for states that require it.

This 2026 Ford F-450 Super Duty Platinum Plus Crew Cab is ordered with Equipment Group 773A and the Platinum Plus Package, and it is trimmed with Platinum Plus Luxury Leather Seats and additional Leather Seats surfaces throughout the cabin. The interior also includes a Panoramic Sunroof, giving the roofline more open light, and a Head Up Display that places select driving information in the driver's forward view. Adaptive Cruise Control and Lane Keep Assist are included, along with SecuriCode Keyless Entry Keypad and a Wi-Fi Hotspot. The cabin's materials and controls are presented in a way that fits the Platinum Plus trim level without adding unnecessary complexity.

This 2026 Ford F-450 Super Duty Platinum Plus Crew Cab is equipped with the FX4 Off-Road Package, a 4.30 Limited Slip Axle Ratio, and a Gooseneck Dual Hitch Kit, which align with its towing-focused role. The spray-in Bedliner - Tough Bed helps protect the cargo area, and Wheel Well Liners - Front are fitted as part of the truck's lower-body protection. The Engine Block Heater is included for cold-weather starts, and the 50 State Emissions System is listed as part of the build. These items work alongside the truck's heavy-duty hardware rather than drawing attention away from it.

This 2026 Ford F-450 Super Duty Platinum Plus Crew Cab keeps the attention on practical equipment, with the dually bed length, towing hardware, and off-road package joined by the higher-end interior and driver-assistance features already noted. The combination of the long cargo box, the dual rear-wheel wheel-and-tire package, and the limited-slip axle ratio gives the truck the kind of specification that suits demanding hauling and travel, while the panoramic roof, leather appointments, and onboard connectivity add comfort during longer drives. This 2026 Ford F-450SD King Ranch DRW in White represents a premium heavy-duty truck engineered for those who demand capability, comfort, and commanding presence on any terrain.

- 6.7L High Output Power Stroke V8 Diesel engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD with FX4 Off-Road Package and Hill Descent Control
- King Ranch Leather 40/Console/40 seats with heated and ventilated front seating
- SYNC 4 with 12" center display and Connected Navigation
- B&O Unleashed Sound System with 14 speakers and SiriusXM with 360L
- Twin panel power moonroof
- 19.5" forged polished aluminum wheels with dual rear wheels
- Heated steering wheel with memory positions
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror and heads-up display
- Electronic Stability Control with traction control and brake assist
- GVWR 14,000 lb payload capacity
- 5G modem with Ford Connectivity Package (1-year included)
- Dual front and side impact airbags with overhead airbag protection

The King Ranch trim elevates this truck with premium leather appointments and distinctive styling that commands respect. The cabin combines luxury with utility, featuring heated and ventilated front seats, power adjustable pedals, and a power driver seat with memory function. Your steering wheel stores personalized settings, while the automatic temperature control maintains comfort across all conditions.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily driving experience. The SYNC 4 infotainment system provides intuitive navigation, while the heads-up display keeps essential information within your line of sight. SiriusXM connectivity keeps you informed and entertained, and the 5G modem enables smart vehicle features throughout your subscription period.

Built for serious work, this truck handles demanding tasks with its diesel engine and robust drivetrain. The FX4 Off-Road Package, Hill Descent Control, and off-road-specifically tuned shock absorbers prepare you for unpredictable terrain. With dual rear wheels and a 14,000 lb GVWR payload package, this Super Duty manages heavy loads with confidence.

Safety features provide comprehensive protection for you and your passengers. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag work with electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes. The emergency communication system through SYNC 4 911 Assist adds an extra layer of security.

This truck combines the refinement you expect from King Ranch with the raw capability of a Super Duty platform. Low mileage and ready for your ownership, this 2026 F-450SD awaits your visit to explore its full potential.

Meet the 2025 Ford F-150 XLT, a truck engineered to handle demanding work and deliver commanding presence on any road. The 360-degree camera system offers complete visibility when maneuvering, while front and rear parking sensors help you navigate tight spaces with confidence. Connected Navigation services come with a complimentary 1-year trial, keeping you informed and on course.

The bed work area reflects practical design with LED lighting for nighttime visibility and four pickup box tie-down plates for securing cargo. The tailgate work surface and step make loading and unloading simpler. Power-sliding rear window functionality adds convenience for longer loads or equipment access.

This 2025 Ford F-150 XLT represents a serious investment in capability, technology, and performance. With 692 miles on the odometer, it stands ready to transition from showroom to your ownership. We invite you to experience this truck firsthand and discover how its combination of raw power, intelligent features, and refined interior can serve your needs.

If you are seeking a heavy-duty pickup that combines unyielding work ethic with premium cabin luxury, you can browse our pre-owned inventory or stop by our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand.===== Exceptional Duramax Diesel Performance and Capability =====Under the hood, this heavy-duty truck is powered by a formidable engine: the Duramax 6.6L V-8 direct injection, intercooled turbo, diesel, engine with 470HP and 975 lb-ft of torque. Output is directed through a smooth-shifting Allison 10-Speed Automatic Transmission paired with a robust *Four Wheel Drive* system featuring an AutoTrac two-speed electronic transfer case. Driver enthusiasm and towing stability remain paramount, allowing you to explore our entire selection of capable trucks built to handle demanding workloads.===== Advanced Technology and First-Class Amenities =====The cabin of the Denali Ultimate serves as an advanced command center tailored for executive comfort. At just over 10,000 miles, this vehicle remains practically new with minimal break-in wear. The cabin demonstrates thoughtful craftsmanship with premium leather-alternative seating, heated and ventilated front seats, and comprehensive climate control including rear air conditioning and dual-zone automatic temperature management. The power-adjustable driver and passenger seats feature memory settings for personalized comfort. Steering wheel heating and premium audio capabilities make every drive more enjoyable. Technology integration keeps you connected and aware on every journey. The navigation system, smartphone projection, and OnStar emergency communication provide modern convenience and peace of mind. Safety features including electronic stability control, brake assist, and a full suite of airbags create multiple layers of occupant protection. Serious off-road capability defines the Extreme Off-Road Package. Electronically locking differentials provide driver control over traction, while full underbody skid plates protect critical components. The forward and rearward underbody cameras offer visibility in challenging situations. Goodyear Wrangler Territory MT tires are engineered for grip on unpaved surfaces, and the black recovery hooks demonstrate preparedness for recovery operations. Distinctive styling includes the illuminated front off-road auxiliary lights, mirror projection lighting with HUMMER EV logos, and MultiPro tailgate step lighting. Rocker protectors with assist steps combine functional protection with purposeful aesthetics. The removable transparent INFINITY roof panels transform the driving experience, allowing natural light and connection to your surroundings. This 2024 GMC HUMMER EV 3X awaits your visit to experience its blend of electric efficiency, premium comfort, and serious capability firsthand.

- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and off-road tuned suspension
- Lariat Ultimate Package featuring Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 with advanced safety systems
- Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Diesel Turbocharged engine with manual exhaust braking
- Pro Power Onboard 2kW with dual alternators for on-site power capability
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 18 speakers and subwoofer
- Tow Technology Package including Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Hitch Assist
- Head-Up Display for enhanced driver awareness
- Power-Deployable Running Boards for convenient entry and exit
- SYNC 4 with Connected Navigation and 911 Assist
- Wireless Charging Pad in leather-trimmed cabin
- Tailgate Step & Handle for practical bed access
- Auto-Dimming Rear-View Mirror with integrated garage door transmitter

This truck combines work-ready performance with luxury amenities. The Power Stroke diesel engine delivers substantial torque while the 10-speed automatic transmission manages power delivery with precision. The FX4 Off-Road Package includes Hill Descent Control, specifically tuned shock absorbers front and rear, plus protective skid plates for the transfer case and fuel tank—features that set this truck apart for serious terrain exploration.

The Lariat Ultimate Package transforms this workhorse into a command center. Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 provides comprehensive driver assistance including automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection, lane-keeping systems, and intelligent adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go capability. The Head-Up Display projects critical information directly into your line of sight, minimizing distraction during operation.

Technology integration runs throughout the cabin. SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition manages navigation, entertainment, and vehicle functions seamlessly. The B&O Unleashed Sound System with 18 speakers and dedicated subwoofer delivers premium audio quality for long days or short hauls. Wireless charging keeps your devices powered while you work.

Comfort and convenience features reflect Lariat-level appointments. Leather-trimmed front bucket seats offer heating, ventilation, and memory positions. Power-deployable running boards deploy automatically when you unlock the truck, then retract when you drive—eliminating the step-up challenge while maintaining aerodynamic efficiency. The heated steering wheel, auto-dimming mirror, and dual-zone climate control ensure comfort during extended use.

The Pro Power Onboard system delivers 2kW of power with dual alternators, making this truck an effective portable power source for job sites or remote locations. The Tow Technology Package adds Pro Trailer Backup Assist with reverse guidance, Pro Trailer Hitch Assist, and integrated trailer cameras—capabilities that make towing and maneuvering significantly more manageable.

Contact us to experience how this F-450SD Lariat DRW combines capability, comfort, and cutting-edge technology in a vehicle engineered for those who demand the best from their trucks.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine delivering 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 2-Speed Active Transfer Case
- AT4 Premium Plus Package including power sunroof and technology upgrades
- Power-Retractable Black Assist Steps with LED lighting
- Bose Premium 7-Speaker Sound System with SiriusXM 360L
- BF Goodrich Off-Road T/A KO3 tires on 20" High Gloss Black aluminum wheels

- Heated and ventilated leather front seats with 10-way power adjustment
- Heated steering wheel and power sunroof

- Automatic Emergency Braking and comprehensive driver assistance systems
- Wireless device charging and connectivity
- Spray-on Pickup Bedliner with GMC Logo

The Sierra 2500HD AT4 delivers commanding presence on the road. The Duramax diesel engine produces impressive torque for towing and hauling, while the truck's off-road suspension and high-clearance step ensure capability in challenging terrain. The 4WD system provides confidence in varied driving conditions, and the multiple camera views make maneuvering and hitching trailers straightforward.

Inside, this truck prioritizes driver comfort and technology. The premium leather seating surfaces are heated and ventilated, adjustable via power controls, while the Bose sound system transforms every drive into a refined audio experience. The 15-inch head-up display keeps critical information visible without distraction, and wireless charging accommodates your devices seamlessly. Climate controls include dual-zone automatic temperature adjustment and heated rear seats for passenger comfort year-round.

Safety and control features reflect modern truck standards. The truck includes automatic emergency braking, lane departure warning, rear cross traffic alert, and trailer side blind zone alert. Ultrasonic parking sensors assist at low speeds, while the hill descent control and exhaust brake provide additional confidence in steep terrain. The security system and remote keyless entry come equipped as standard protection.

The AT4 trim elevates this Sierra with distinctive styling and purposeful upgrades. The gloss black header grille and LED cargo lighting create a commanding appearance, while the spray-on bedliner protects the truck bed from wear. Front fog lights enhance visibility, and the winter grille cover reflects thoughtful design for seasonal variations.

This 2026 Sierra 2500HD AT4 has been carefully maintained and is ready to serve your needs with diesel efficiency and proven durability. The combination of capability, comfort, and technology makes this truck a practical investment for work and leisure. We invite you to experience the commanding presence and refined performance this truck delivers firsthand at our showroom.

This 2024 GMC Sierra 2500HD AT4 in Volcanic Red Tintcoat delivers the capability and refinement you need for serious work and confident daily driving.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD
- AT4 Premium Plus Package with power sunroof

- HD Surround Vision with Bed View Camera and Trailer Camera Provisions

Built on the AT4 platform, this Sierra 2500HD combines off-road readiness with premium comfort. The legendary Duramax diesel engine delivers the torque and efficiency needed for heavy loads, while the 2-Speed Active Transfer Case and off-road suspension handle challenging terrain with confidence. The spray-on bedliner with AT4 logo protects your investment, and the gooseneck prep package stands ready for your trailer needs.

Inside, you'll find genuine thoughtfulness in every detail. Heated and ventilated leather seats keep you comfortable in any season, while the 10-way power adjustable driver's seat with lumbar support ensures a proper fit for long drives. The Multicolor Head-Up Display keeps critical information in your line of sight, and the integrated trailering system with trailer brake controller and tire pressure monitors provides the oversight professionals demand.

Technology integrates seamlessly throughout the cabin. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you connected, while the Bose audio system delivers quality sound for your commute or jobsite. OnStar and GMC Connected Services provide remote access and support when you need it most. Forward collision alert, automatic emergency braking, and lane departure warning add layers of safety awareness.

This AT4 is equipped to earn its place in your garage. Whether you're managing a demanding job, towing premium equipment, or covering long distances, this truck brings engineering designed for performance and reliability. The 220-amp alternator and engine block heater support year-round operation, while the heavy-duty 80 amp battery ensures dependable starts.

We invite you to experience this Sierra 2500HD in person. Contact us today to schedule a showing and put this capable truck through its paces.

This 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali Ultimate in Silver delivers premium capability and refinement designed for those who demand both performance and sophistication in their truck.

- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Super Cruise hands-free driving assistance with automatic lane changing and 3-year subscription
- Carbon fiber composite bed with spray-on bedliner and Denali logo
- Premium floor liners with removable carpet inserts
- Engine block heater for cold-weather reliability
- Bose Premium Series 12-speaker audio system with SiriusXM 360L
- GMC Infotainment system with navigation and wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- 15-inch multicolor head-up display with following distance indicator
- Full grain leather seating with 16-way power adjusters and lumbar support
- Heated and ventilated front seats with heated rear outboard seating
- Power moonroof with power sliding rear window
- 22-inch 7-spoke ultra-bright machined alloy wheels
- Denali premium suspension with adaptive ride control and dual active exhaust
- HD surround vision with bed view camera and trailer-side blind zone alert
- Advanced safety features including forward collision alert, lane keep assist, and rear cross traffic braking

The Denali Ultimate stands out with its combination of luxury appointments and functional upgrades that enhance both daily driving and trailering. The carbon fiber composite bed resists dents and scratches while maintaining the truck's distinctive appearance, and the premium floor liners protect the cabin from the elements. Super Cruise technology brings hands-free convenience to compatible roads, while the adaptive suspension system ensures a refined ride regardless of load or terrain conditions.

Inside, the cabin reflects genuine attention to detail with full grain leather trim, genuine wood accents on the dashboard, doors, and console, and ambient lighting that creates an upscale atmosphere. The 16-way power seats with lumbar support and heating and ventilation capabilities provide comfort on long drives, and the panoramic power moonroof adds to the sense of space and openness throughout the cabin.

Technology integration is comprehensive with the GMC Infotainment system offering navigation, wireless connectivity for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and a Wi-Fi hotspot capability. The Bose audio system delivers quality sound with 12 speakers strategically positioned throughout the truck, while SiriusXM 360L satellite radio provides entertainment options everywhere you travel.

For those who tow, this truck is equipped with integrated trailering technology including an in-vehicle trailering system app, integrated trailer brake controller, and trailer tire pressure monitoring. The hitch guidance and hitch view camera systems simplify backing up with a trailer, making the towing experience safer and more manageable.

This 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali Ultimate represents a complete premium truck package, combining capability with comfort. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience how this truck handles and feels on the road.

The Z71 package delivers off-road suspension, all-terrain traction, and protective underbody components.

description:
This 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD LTZ in gray delivers the capability and features you need for serious work and daily reliability.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD
- Z71 Sport Edition package with black styling and all-terrain tires
- Z71 Off-Road Package including off-road suspension and Hill Descent Control
- Multi-Flex Tailgate with six functional load and access features
- Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package for heavy hauling
- Snow Plow Prep/Camper Package with 220-amp alternator and skid plates
- LTZ Plus Package including convenience features, heated seats, and safety technology
- Power sunroof on crew cab
- Adaptive Cruise Control and speed control
- HD Surround Vision and Bed View Camera with trailer camera provisions
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio
- Heated front and rear seats
- Wireless charging and Wi-Fi hotspot capable

This truck combines professional-grade capability with thoughtful comfort features. The Duramax diesel engine delivers the torque you need for towing and hauling, while the 4WD system keeps you moving through challenging conditions. The Z71 Off-Road Package adds suspension refinement and hill descent control for added confidence on varied terrain. The Multi-Flex Tailgate provides multiple access options, and the Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package means you're ready for serious trailers.

Inside, the crew cab offers comfortable seating with heated front and rear seats, memory settings for the driver, and a heated steering wheel. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System keeps you connected with smartphone integration, satellite radio, and available Wi-Fi hotspot capability. Modern convenience features include power windows, power door locks, push-button start, and a surround-view camera system that helps with visibility when maneuvering.

The LTZ Plus Package rounds out the offering with adaptive cruise control, a rear sliding power window, and the universal home remote for added control. The spray-on black bedliner protects the truck bed, while power-adjustable pedals and tilt-and-telescope steering accommodate different driver preferences.

This Silverado 3500HD is Chevrolet Certified Pre-Owned, which means it has undergone rigorous inspection by certified technicians and meets strict quality standards. You have peace of mind knowing this truck has been evaluated for mechanical soundness and overall condition. Certified Pre-Owned vehicles reflect Chevrolet's commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

We exist to earn the trust and repeated business of every customer we meet."

description:
This 2024 Ford F-350 Super Duty Lariat stands out as a powerful and versatile pickup designed to meet the demands of work and adventure alike. With a striking Race Red exterior and a robust 6.7-liter turbocharged diesel engine delivering up to 500 horsepower and 1200 lb-ft of torque at 2600 and 1600 RPM respectively, this used truck offers exceptional towing and hauling capabilities. With just over 52,000 miles, it combines proven performance with reliability. The 4X4 drivetrain ensures off-road and tough terrain handling, while the spacious five-passenger cab provides comfort with heated seats, rear heated seats, and premium features like memory seats and keyless entry. Modern technology is integrated seamlessly, including Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, a navigation system, a 12-inch infotainment screen, and a premium audio setup with seven speakers and a subwoofer, making every drive enjoyable and connected.

This F-350 Lariat also offers a suite of advanced safety and security features to protect you and your cargo. Rear automatic emergency braking and parking sensors enhance parking and maneuvering, while four-wheel ABS provides stability in challenging conditions. Security is prioritized with interior motion sensors, anti-tow sensors, and an anti-theft system, complemented by programmable safety keys and auto-locking power door locks to prevent unauthorized access. Emergency braking preparation and power door locks further support safety, ensuring peace of mind on every journey. Whether hauling heavy loads or navigating busy streets, this truck provides confidence and security at every turn.

2024 Ford F-350 Super Duty Safety and Security Features

The safety and security package includes rear automatic emergency braking for quick response to obstacles, rear parking sensors to assist with parking, and 4-wheel ABS for optimal stopping power. Interior motion sensors and anti-tow sensors safeguard against theft, while an anti-theft system adds extra protection. Emergency braking preparation helps prevent collisions, and power door locks with anti-lockout and auto-locking features secure the vehicle. A programmable safety key offers personalized access, giving you full control over security settings.

2024 Ford F-350 Super Duty Entertainment and Technology Features

This truck is equipped with a 12-inch infotainment touchscreen that provides intuitive access to entertainment and navigation. FordPass Connect enables smart device app compatibility for remote start and cabin preconditioning, while voice-operated hands-free calling and radio keep you connected without distraction. The premium audio system produces 640 watts through seven speakers, including a subwoofer, for rich sound. HD radio ensures high-quality broadcasts, and the system supports features like engine start and climate control through smartphone apps, making every drive both enjoyable and convenient.

2024 Ford F-350 Super Duty Performance Features

Performance is at the core of this truck with an electronic hi-lo 4WD selector that allows for easy switching between two-wheel and four-wheel drive modes. The part-time 4WD system ensures optimal traction and stability in various driving conditions, making this truck well-suited for tough jobs and rough terrains. Its proven powertrain and drivetrain design deliver dependable performance, whether towing heavy loads or navigating challenging off-road environments.

- 120-volt bed and instrument panel power outlets for tool and equipment charging
- Heated and ventilated front seats with heated 2nd row outboard seats

The truck's exterior presents a commanding black finish complemented by the gloss black header grille and grille insert bars characteristic of the AT4 model. The 20" high-gloss black aluminum wheels reinforce its purposeful stance. Inside, perforated leather-appointed front seat trim combined with heated and ventilated seating creates a comfortable cab environment. The spray-on bedliner bearing the AT4 logo protects your cargo investment while maintaining the truck's refined appearance.

Built on the Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel foundation with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability, this Sierra 2500HD is engineered for substantial hauling and towing demands. The 2-speed active transfer case and off-road suspension provide the mechanical foundation for the X31 Off-Road Package, enabling confident navigation across varied terrain. The integrated trailer brake controller and hitch guidance system support safe towing operations, while the gooseneck/5th wheel prep package accommodates specialized hauling configurations.

Technology integration throughout the cabin keeps you connected and informed. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto functionality merge smartphone capabilities with the premium GMC infotainment system. The Bose sound system with SiriusXM 360L delivers quality audio, while wireless charging and multiple USB ports throughout the cabin support your devices. The multicolor 15" head-up display presents critical driving information directly in your line of sight, reducing the need to look away from the road.

Safety and convenience features work together to support your daily driving. Automatic emergency braking, lane departure warning, and forward collision alert provide active protection. The HD surround vision system with bed view camera and trailer camera provisions offers comprehensive visibility for parking and towing operations. Remote vehicle starter, push button start, and the universal home remote enhance daily practicality.

This truck has been serviced, inspected, and fully detailed to ensure it arrives at your driveway ready for use. Its 29,474 miles represent careful operation and proper maintenance, supporting years of reliable service ahead. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the combination of capability and refinement this Sierra 2500HD AT4 provides for your work and lifestyle needs.

Meet the 2026 Ram 3500 Big Horn, a heavy-duty diesel truck built to handle serious work and deliver the capability you need.

- 50-Gallon Fuel Tank
- Dual Rear Wheels with 6000# Front Axle
- Max Tow Package with 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Towing Prep
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 12" Touchscreen Display and Apple CarPlay
- 9 Alpine Speakers with Subwoofer and SiriusXM with 360L
- Heated Front Seats and Heated Steering Wheel
- MOPAR Spray-In Bedliner and Deployable Bed Step

This truck combines work-ready durability with thoughtful comfort features. The 6.7L Cummins diesel engine provides the muscle you expect from a Ram 3500, paired with a robust four-wheel-drive system and dual rear wheels for maximum traction and load capacity. The 50-gallon fuel tank ensures extended range between fill-ups, critical for professionals who spend long days on the job.

Inside, you'll find premium appointments including heated bucket seats, a luxury steering wheel, and an 8-way power-adjustable driver seat with lumbar support. The Uconnect 5 navigation system offers seamless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay, while the 9 Alpine speakers with subwoofer deliver quality audio. Climate control operates through dual-zone automatic temperature adjustment, keeping driver and passenger comfortable regardless of season.

The Night Edition package adds distinctive style with gloss black grille inserts, black exterior truck badging, and painted front and rear bumpers. Exterior mirrors feature heating elements and power telescoping adjustment for enhanced visibility. LED bed lighting illuminates your work area, while the MOPAR spray-in bedliner protects your cargo investment.

Towing capability is enhanced through the Max Tow Package, which includes 5th wheel and gooseneck towing preparation. The truck sits on 17" polished aluminum wheels with Nexen all-season tires, supported by a heavy-duty suspension designed for payload and trailer demands.

Storage solutions abound with dual glove boxes, locking lower storage compartment, and folding flat load floor storage in the cabin. The MOPAR deployable bed step provides easy access to cargo, while the spray-in bedliner guards against daily wear.

This 2026 Ram 3500 Big Horn represents the perfect balance of capability, comfort, and technology for owners who refuse to compromise on any front.

This 2026 Ram 3500 Big Horn delivers the capability and comfort you need for work and life. Built with a 6.7L I6 turbocharged diesel engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck is engineered to handle demanding tasks while maintaining daily drivability.

- 6.7L I6 Diesel Turbocharged Engine (Cummins)
- 4WD with 8-Speed Automatic Transmission

Technology keeps you connected with the Uconnect 5 system, 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot, and integrated voice command with Bluetooth. Navigation pages specifically designed for trailers and off-road driving provide confidence on any terrain. The ParkView rear backup camera and emergency vehicle alert system enhance safety during maneuvering.

The truck features delay-off headlights, fully automatic headlights, and front fog lights for visibility in various conditions.

This Ram 3500 Big Horn combines the high output diesel performance you expect with premium technology and thought-out storage solutions. Whether you're hauling equipment, towing a trailer, or managing daily responsibilities, this truck is ready for the job.
